description: HW7 Part 2/3 fixed verification cases over the HW5 fixture store (3 listings). Each case needs at least two tool calls; `check` is the deterministic verifier used by Part 3.

cases.title: search, then detail-lookup the first result
cases.prompt: Search for Apartment listings, then look up the full details of the first result and tell me its address, rent and owner.

cases.title: aggregate question, then one supporting example
cases.prompt: What is the average monthly rent of Apartment listings? Then find one Apartment listing that supports the answer.

cases.title: compare two entities with search plus two detail lookups
cases.prompt: Compare listing L-6758-001 and listing L-6758-002: search for them, look up the details of both, and say which one is cheaper.

error_case.title: nonexistent id
error_case.prompt: Show me the full details for listing id 9999.
